<title level="1" pfs="">[Mist Bear](/Monsters.aspx?ID=3273)</title>

<row gap="medium">

<column gap="medium" flex="1 1 400px">

Like the mundane bears they resemble, a mist bear is motivated by simple pursuits, such as food. Unlike other ursines, the mist bear can dissipate into a cloud of ethereal vapor, greatly complicating the efforts of neighboring humanoids to keep their provisions safe from the creature's depredations.

 Fortunately, the mist bear follows a predictable pattern of behavior, usually foraging within [the Universe](/Planes.aspx?ID=26) for only a few months every year to gorge itself. Once sated, it then enters a state similar to hibernation where it drifts through the [Ethereal Plane](/Planes.aspx?ID=34) as a cloud of intangible vapor.

</column>

<title level="2" right="Creature 7">[Mist Bear](/Monsters.aspx?ID=3273)</title>

<traits>
<trait label="Uncommon" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=721" />
<trait label="Large" />
<trait label="Beast" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=547" />
<trait label="Ethereal" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=593" />
</traits>

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [Howl of the Wild](/Sources.aspx?ID=226) pg. 147

**Perception** +18; [darkvision](/MonsterAbilities.aspx?ID=59), [scent](/MonsterAbilities.aspx?ID=74) ([imprecise](/Rules.aspx?ID=412)) 30 feet

**Languages**

**Skills**
[Athletics](/Skills.aspx?ID=36) +17, [Survival](/Skills.aspx?ID=49) +15

<row gap="medium">
**Str** +6

**Dex** +2

**Con** +5

**Int** -3

**Wis** +4

**Cha** +2
</row>

**Mist Form** ([concentrate](/Traits.aspx?ID=561), [exploration](/Traits.aspx?ID=595), [occult](/Traits.aspx?ID=662), [polymorph](/Traits.aspx?ID=670)) Over the course of a minute, a mist bear can transmute its form into a cloud of ethereal vapor. In this state it has resistance 10 to physical damage, is immune to precision damage, and can't use any actions with the attack or [manipulate](/Traits.aspx?ID=645) trait. It has a fly Speed of 10 feet and can slip through tiny cracks. The mist bear can return to solid form as a single action.

</column>

---

<column gap="tiny">

<row gap="medium">
**AC** 24 

**Fort** +16 

**Ref** +13 

**Will** +15 

</row>

<row gap="medium">
**HP** 140

</row>

</column>

---

<column gap="tiny">

**Speed** 35 feet

**Melee**
<actions string="Single Action" />
jaws +17,
**Damage** 2d10+8 piercing

**Melee**
<actions string="Single Action" />
claw +17 ([Agile](/Traits.aspx?ID=170)),
**Damage** 2d8+8 slashing plus [Grab](/MonsterAbilities.aspx?ID=45)

**Clouded Charge** <actions string="Two Actions" /> ([Concentrate](/Traits.aspx?ID=32), [Occult](/Traits.aspx?ID=120), [Visual](/Traits.aspx?ID=163)) The mist bear Strides twice. During this movement, wisps of ethereal smoke trail from its body, making it [concealed](/Conditions.aspx?ID=62). The mist bear then Strikes. The target is [off-guard](/Conditions.aspx?ID=58) to this attack if the bear moved at least 20 feet.

**Misty Mauling** <actions string="Single Action" /> ([Concentrate](/Traits.aspx?ID=32), [Occult](/Traits.aspx?ID=120), [Polymorph](/Traits.aspx?ID=127)) **Requirements** The mist bear has a creature [grabbed](/Conditions.aspx?ID=77); **Effect** The mist bear digs its claws into the grabbed creature as it dissipates into mist. The grabbed creature takes 3d8 slashing damage (DC 25 [basic](/Rules.aspx?ID=329) Fortitude save). The mist bear gains the benefits of its Mist Form, [Flies](/Actions.aspx?ID=2312)up to 10 feet, and then returns to its solid form.

</column>
